**About the Organisation \& Role:**

* Optimise performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation and proactive improvements.

* Hands\-on experience building and operating recommendation and personalisation capabilities.
* Expertise in backend engineering, API design, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and scalable integration patterns using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
* Experience integrating and operationalising LLM APIs and AI services within production applications.
* Experience working with feature stores, vector databases, embedding based retrieval and modern ML architectures will be a strong advantage.
* Experience with Redis or equivalent caching systems.
* Experience with observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred.
